title.narrative: Yerevan Metro Rehabilitation Project - Phase II

description.narrative: The Project will provide an overhaul of the Yerevan metro system. It will address public health and safety concerns that were identified in the due-diligence for Phase I including water ingress in the metro tunnel, fire protection equipment and occupational health and safety issues in relation to the train washing facility and training of staff. The Project will improve the daily lives of the citizens of Yerevan through the provision of better infrastructure.

description.narrative: Procurement and implementation in a timely manner of the contracts financed by EBRD, EIB and the Commission without any substantiated complaints from contractors

comment.narrative: There is no baseline indicator described in the DoA so to measure the success of the above indicator the imaginary baseline was filled in as No.
The aim was to fulfil the indicator above which is why the final target is set as Yes.

The Project Progress Report covering period up to 31 March 2020 under Section 7 on pages 16 to 18 indicates the following points with regards to achievement of the current indicator From the beginning of works the Contractor showed slow performance of works as well as it was slow in submitting methodologies and other important documents to the Engineers review and approval. Several meetings took place between the Contractor the Employer and the Engineer for the purpose of discussion and resolution of project related issues thus avoiding further delays. The Contractors delays were attributed mainly to its failure to fulfil prerequisites for starting the tunnelling works as well as import of equipment and other organizational issues. The Consultant issued Notices to Correct to remediate deficiencies regarding Contractors personnel Contractors equipment handling of ground water ingress in the drainage tunnel excavation and support sequence to submit a revised detail design for Section B Remedial Works in Metro Tunnel and to comply with the Engineers requests and Contract Subclause 8.6 Rate of Progress. The Contractor requested 12 additional months and found this term to be realistic for completion of works for completion of the project and stated that the term requested did not include implementation of optional items envisaged under the Contract. The Employer though did not share opinion of the Contractor regarding the Contractors ability to complete the works within requested additional months. The Employer has decided not to terminate Agazos Work Contract however among others to apply Delay Damages starting from 19.08.2017 because the contractual Completion Date 18.08.2017 is not met by Contractor Agazos. During the reporting period the tunnelling progress of the Contractor was rather constant however still at insufficient rate.

title.narrative: Environmental and Social Action Plan implemented

description.narrative: Environmental and Social Action Plan implemented

comment.narrative: The Progress Report of the intervention covering covering period up to 31 March 2020 under Section 13 on page 31 indicates that Yerevan Metro submits Annual Environmental Social Report AESR to the EBRD on annual basis. AESR for 2014 was sent to the Bank in May 2015. AESR for 2015 was sent to the Bank in March 2016. AESR for 2016 was sent to the Bank in May 2017. AESR for 2017 was sent to the Bank in April 2018. AESR for 2018 was sent to the Bank in March 2019. AESR for 2019 will be sent to the Bank in March 2020.Furthermore it is stated that Yerevan Metro with the help of the EBRD has developed an Integrated Environmental and Social Management and Monitoring Plan for Phase II of Yerevan Metro Rehabilitation Project that will be guiding document for Yerevan Metro through 2017.

title.narrative: Water ingress problem remedied

description.narrative: Water ingress problem remedied

comment.narrative: The Project Progress Report covering period up to 31 March 2020 under Section 10 on page 27 states The overall goal of the project is to substantially reduce the water inflow into the Metro tunnels and to improve the tunnel environment and maintainability. Main criteria among others to achieve the project goal are the lowering of the groundwater table and reduction of flowing water in the Metro Tunnels. Measurements at the piezometers No. 8 and 9 show that the groundwater table has been significantly lowered since start of the construction works. Graphs produced by the PISConsultant indicate that the lowering of the groundwater table can be linked to the drainage tunnel extension and hence would show a success of the project.

title.narrative: Water ingress problem remedied

description.narrative: Water ingress problem remedied

comment.narrative: The Project Progress Report covering period up to 31 March 2020 under Section 10 on page 27 states The overall goal of the project is to substantially reduce the water inflow into the Metro tunnels and to improve the tunnel environment and maintainability. Main criteria among others to achieve the project goal are the lowering of the groundwater table and reduction of flowing water in the Metro Tunnels. Measurements at the piezometers No. 8 and 9 show that the groundwater table has been significantly lowered since start of the construction works. Graphs produced by the PISConsultant indicate that the lowering of the groundwater table can be linked to the drainage tunnel extension and hence would show a success of the project.
